notes.title: Newer version of Unity Input system, logo update
notes.notes:
I upgraded to a newer version of the Unity input system, this is in preparation for the key rebinding. 

Updated the Logo. 

I don't expect this one to cause any issues, I've been playing on it for a few days, but please let me know if anyone sees any problems.

Also, please don't opt into the beta branch right now, there's nothing on it. I set one up very briefly to test but there's no build associated with it right now. 

Thank you!

notes.title: Skip pre-game screen, some art iterations
notes.notes:
If the player cant do anything on the perks screen yet, skip the pre-game (perks) screen. No meta money to spend and no perks unlocked yet means no reason to show the perks screen. 

Forty five pistol now looks more like a glock.

notes.title: Gun Knight All Day Release Day! Roadmap and controller support
notes.notes:
Happy Gun Knight All Day release day! 

I'm thrilled to share the game with everyone today, but I just wanted to mention a couple of things that are NOT in the game at this time. 

I recommend playing with an Xbox style controller if you have one, that's my personal preference. PS5 controllers do not work with the game currently. I didn't have any luck with them nor did the playtesters. 
PS4 controllers do work. Keyboard and mouse is always a control option. I may try to support PS5 controllers at a later time but they are not there right now.

Control rebinding - I did not get to this yet. I will almost certainly get to this in an update. 

The game is Windows only. 

That's all the less than pleasant stuff. 

Thank you for checking out the game, I hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Release Date May 22nd!
notes.notes:
Gun Knight All Day releases May 22nd! 

Meanwhile I'll be squashing bugs, polishing, and balancing. I just added a perks system with unlockable perks which I'm really excited about.

I hope to see you there on May 22nd!

Thanks for checking out Gun Knight All Day.

-Midge

From Midge Makes Games

notes.title: Gun Knight All Day is on the way!
notes.notes:
Hello! Thank you for your interest in Gun Knight All Day. Please wishlist if you haven't already. If you have, thank you!

I just wanted to break the radio silence on this game since I haven't made any announcements on the steam page yet. 

The original release date was listed as Q2 2023, and I that looks to still be on track. I'm hoping to announce a more specific release date in the near future. 

The game is playable, solid and fun. It's currently pretty challenging. 

So I'm prioritizing everything I need to do to call this game "done". Right now that means balancing, polishing, bug-fixing, and lots of testing. 

I'm still having a lot of fun playing this game, and I can't wait to share it with everyone.

Hang in there, and I want to thank everyone for the supportive comments, likes, and wishlists. 

Gun Knight All Day is on the way

Take care everyone. 

-Midge from Midge Makes Games.
